name: upload
description: Adds a file. One field and one button, because a form is the better thing here; the file becomes a record whose contents are read into text the page renders with structure and search finds.

use.when: a person wants to bring a document, a spreadsheet, a web page, a PDF or a picture into the workspace.
use.not: writing something new, which is a note, or a link to something that stays elsewhere, which is a link.
use.with: the files page, where it lives by default, or the header at compact size when a person adds files often.

from.description: The page to return to afterwards; the file's own page when left out.

id.description: Id of the field, so the label reaches it.

a11y.role: form with a labelled file field and a submit button

keyboard.does: moves to the field, then the button
on the field, opens the file chooser; on the button, adds the file

wcag.notes: A visible label (3.3.2) and a real multipart form, so it works without a script. The native file field keeps every platform's own chooser and screen reader support.

machine.identify: A form with enctype multipart/form-data; the file field is named file, and title is optional.
machine.operate: POST the form with a file, or POST /t/file/upload directly; the record appears at /t/file and in /api/file.
